image_description: A vintage Atari Portfolio handheld computer is open on a desk. It features a clamshell design with a monochrome LCD screen on the top half displaying 'Atari Portfolio' text, and a full-sized QWERTY keyboard on the bottom half. The casing is dark grey/black plastic. In the background, there are papers, cables, and other office clutter.
